verdict.rationale: Qodo runs actions automatically on pull request events: it reviews every PR once connected, lets users control when reviews run (manual or automatic), and auto-publishes risk labels. These behaviors can be configured as code via .pr_agent.toml or in the portal. Its 'rule system' is about coding standards enforced during review, not a general user-defined event-to-action automation engine, so the story is only partly met. Missing for 10: a general rule builder for arbitrary event triggers and actions, events beyond PR lifecycle, detailed docs on trigger conditions, and independent hands-on corroboration.
